name: The Taco Stand
menu_notes: Dish names/descriptions confirmed against letstaco.com's own menu page (Carne Asada, Al Pastor, Baja, Camaron, Pescado/Mahi Mahi, Mushroom, Sonora, California all present, correctly spelled). Prices checked against allmenus.com (third-party aggregator): 7/10 within $1, but California Burrito ($10.49 vs $9.02), Al Pastor Burrito ($9.99 vs $8.07) and Carne Asada Fries ($10.89 vs $9.33) drift over $1. A separate web search suggested even higher delivery-app pricing ($12.59 burrito). source_url is 'chain-shared:restaurant/488', i.e. this menu was copied from a different Taco Stand location rather than scraped specifically for La Jolla, which likely explains the drift.
data_notes: Address '621 Pearl Street, La Jolla' matches exactly (Yelp/Toast/Tripadvisor all cite 621 Pearl St). Neighborhood and cuisine (Mexican) correct. Hours match a live web search exactly for all 7 days: Mon-Thu & Sun 9am-9pm, Fri-Sat 9am-10pm. lat/lng (32.8394, -117.2768) correctly lands in La Jolla, San Diego County. No signs the restaurant is closed; Yelp shows current Sept 2026 activity.
issues: Menu is 'chain-shared' from a different Taco Stand location (restaurant/488) rather than La Jolla-specific; 3 of 10 checked prices drift more than $1 from third-party pricing, consistent with cross-location reuse
